gaps: Tab. 31.2 is a partial disaggregation, not a full unit process: Boustead's cumulative energy and waste have been pulled out into technosphere exchanges (electricity, heavy fuel oil, natural gas furnace, tap water, two disposal services, transport, chemical plant), but the chemistry has not - there is no epichlorohydrin and no bisphenol A line, although the dataset's own ecoSpold technology field says 'Production from epichlorohydrin and bisphenol-A' and BAFU carries unit processes for both ('Epichlorohydrin, from hypochlorination of allyl chloride, at plant' and 'Bisphenol A, powder, at plant'). What is left in the elementary flows below - 1.8 kg of rock salt, 0.98 kg of chloride to water, 0.38 kg of sodium to water - is the chlor-alkali chain of the epichlorohydrin still sitting in the direct flows.
1200 kg of sand per kg of resin (see the item note) is transcribed as printed and is almost certainly wrong in the source.

Six of the eight waste-treatment services that the aggregated dataset carries (spoil from coal mining, incineration residue, hazardous waste to underground deposit, facilities chemical production, plastics to sanitary landfill, wood to incineration, tailings) appear in Tab. 31.1 but not in Tab. 31.2, which keeps only the two municipal-solid-waste lines.
No land use and no soil emissions, as chapter 31 says for the whole Boustead family.
The report gives no uncertainty ('Uncertainty for LCI results cannot be determined' on every line).
